Learn more > A heated Premier League matchup comes to North London Saturday as Tottenham host Brighton. Tottenham stepped into a new era just weeks ago with Roberto De Zerbi appointed as head coach, giving Igor Tudor the boot. Spurs have yet to flip the script, though — the squad lost a 1-0 league match to Sunderland over the weekend, and still remain in the bottom three. Editor's Picks De Zerbi is also familiar with Brighton, having managed the club from 2022-24. The Seagulls have recently claimed wins over Sunderland, Liverpool and Burnley, putting them mid-table at 46 points and just behind Everton and Brentford.
